voice_authorization: Creator explicitly selected Holden as default on 2026-10-30.
controls_status: Creator requests faster native expressive delivery. speech_rate 30 is the provisional new-project baseline; historical rate 20 and accepted files remain unchanged. Measure and listen to a pilot before claiming calibrated quality.
delivery_goal: Expressive conversational storytelling addressed to one listener; meaning-led emphasis and natural energy/pitch/rhythm changes, with brisk connected speech and brief purposeful pauses.
creative_priority: Quality and detailed expressive direction take priority over price; do not shorten useful performance cues solely to reduce cost.

calibration.policy: Use the same voice, text and delivery direction for a bounded native-speed comparison. Judge clarity, meaning-led expression and pauses as well as speed; do not assume provider units are a percentage.

tempo_edit.purpose: Optional modest pitch-preserving adjustment after measured generation, separate from pause editing.

scope: Default for this creator unless they override it; do not infer that this is accepted listening quality or reset nonzero speed to zero.
